text:
MPC edged up 0.44% today to $414.65, extending a sharp recovery from last week's lows. The stock has climbed nearly $42 in five days as crude prices stabilized and refinery utilization remained robust at 95.2%, signaling steady demand for refined products. With US oil holding around $89.62 per barrel and gasoline inventories at reasonable levels, the refining margin environment appears stable enough to support continued gains.

The broader backdrop has shifted slightly in refiners' favor over the past few days. Geopolitical tensions around Iran and the Gulf appear to be easing based on recent Trump administration statements about peace prospects, which has capped oil price downside and reduced supply-disruption fears. At the same time, Russian crude production is back online following recent deals, which does add to global supply — but refineries are running hot and storage levels remain moderate, so the market is absorbing that output without collapsing margins.
